tasks.title: Announcement #74
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement on the school radio.
tasks.transcript: Attention, students, the campus bookstore will be holding a special sale tomorrow from 8 a.m. To 6 p.m. All textbooks and supplies will be discounted by 20%. Don't miss this great opportunity to stock up for the semester.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.B: A special sale at the campus bookstore

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：The campus bookstore will be holding a special sale tomorrow from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. All textbooks and supplies will be discounted by 20%. 选项分析： A. New arrivals at the bookstore 书店的新到商品。公告中未提及新到商品，所以A选项错误。 B. A special sale at the campus bookstore 校园书店的特别促销活动。公告明确宣布明天有折扣促销，所以B选项正确。 C. A change in bookstore hours 书店营业时间的变更。公告中未提及时间变更，所以C选项错误。 D. A new bookstore opening 一家新书店的开业。公告中未提及新书店，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What should students do according to the announcement?

options.A: Visit the bookstore during the sale

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：根据公告，学生应该做什么？ 定位原文：Don't miss this great opportunity to stock up for the semester. 选项分析： A. Visit the bookstore during the sale 在促销期间去书店。公告鼓励学生利用机会囤货，即去书店购买，所以A选项正确。 B. Order supplies online 在线订购用品。公告中未提及在线订购，所以B选项错误。 C. Check out new books 查看新书。公告中未提及新书，所以C选项错误。 D. Return their textbooks 归还他们的教科书。公告中未提及归还，所以D选项错误。
